purpose: Public explanation of teaching-source privacy boundaries; not the private replacement map
examples: Personal addresses use RFC-reserved example domains; deployed origins are not included
configuration: Own project, mailbox, UI owner, service origins and fixed return must be explicitly configured
cloud_release: Manual plus separate PUBLIC_SOURCE_DEPLOY_ENABLED operator opt-in; source pushes do not deploy
history: Original repository history is handled separately by the owner and must be checked for residual object access
deployment: No running agent configuration, key, access control, IAM or OAuth setting is changed by source sanitization
license: No root license has been selected
public_metadata: The existing GitHub repository/owner identity remains visible; anonymity is not claimed
